flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4173 then enter 50 in the Bill amount field
set Number of people to 0
click Calculate
then verify an error message asking for at least 1 person is visible

summary:

The form displayed an error stating that at least 1 person is required, so no calculation was completed with zero people.
